item.title: Many of Amazon's Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals are often deceptive, think tank says
item.description: Many Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals on Amazon may incorrectly lead you to believe that you're saving money, according to a report from the economic think tank Groundwork Collaborative. Amazon says the report is deeply flawed and contains false claims. Lindsay Owens, president and CEO of Groundwork Collaborative, joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Here's what might be causing the string of tech-related outages
item.description: The federal government and multiple U.S. companies, including Microsoft, Apple and United, experienced tech-related issues over the past week. Some are blaming the rush to patch up vulnerabilities discovered by AI. Independent AI adviser Walter Pasquarelli joins "The Daily Report."

item.title: Large-scale data centers using as much power as some states and countries, study warns
item.description: In 2024, U.S. data centers consumed almost as much electricity as states like California and Florida, according to a new study. Harvard scientist Gianluca Guidi, the lead researcher on that study, joins "The Daily Report" to share more.

item.title: White House drops Heidi Overton's nomination for FDA commissioner
item.description: The White House has dropped the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton, President Trump's pick for FDA commissioner, CBS News has confirmed.

item.title: Man convicted in Iran-backed plot to kill Trump is sentenced
item.description: A man who was convicted of attempted terrorism and murder-for-hire plots, with potential targets including President Trump and former President Joe Biden, was sentenced to 27 1/2 years in federal prison.

item.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27.5 years for Iran-backed plot to murder Trump
item.description: Pakistani man Asif Merchant was sentenced to 27.5 years in prison on Tuesday for his role in an Iran-backed plot to assassinate President Trump and other U.S. political figures. CBS News' Katrina Kaufman has the details.

item.title: Nvidia shares strong results in first earnings report after Huang's resignation
item.description: AI giant Nvidia shared strong results in its first quarterly earnings report following the resignation of former CEO Jensen Huang over an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady has more.

item.title: Duffy asks for $50 billion for FAA after ground stop
item.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy renewed his call for $50 billion in funding for FAA upgrades during an appearance on Capitol Hill Tuesday. CBS News' Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: Strangers team up to drive from Chicago to Nashville during last week's ground stop
item.description: On Friday, over 1 million passengers were stranded at airports, but one group of strangers teamed up to make a break for it. They drove eight hours from Chicago's Midway Airport to Nashville. Matt Gutman has the story.

item.title: Terrifying close call between students and pickup truck at bus stop caught on camera
item.description: A Virginia mom said she is still losing sleep over a close call between two of her children and a speeding pickup truck. It happened when her kids were crossing the road to board a school bus last week. Skyler Henry has more.

item.title: Outages hit NSA and Apple in latest round of tech turmoil
item.description: The National Security Agency and Apple both faced technology disruptions Tuesday, adding to issues that hit Microsoft, the FAA, major banks and more over the past week. The incidents have raised fears of possible cybersecurity threats against the U.S., though officials say there is no evidence of a cyberattack. CBS News' Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: 911 call released in ESPN analyst Rex Ryan's alleged hit-and-run
item.description: 911 audio obtained by the New York Post details a Nashville attorney's call describing the moment he and his wife were allegedly hit by former NFL coach Rex Ryan's pickup truck. Tom Hanson reports.

item.title: Mountain of trash explodes in Los Angeles County: "Absolutely our worst nightmare"
item.description: What looked like a volcanic eruption in Los Angeles County was actually a high-pressure explosion from a mountain of trash. Carter Evans has the latest updates.

item.title: Nvidia sees strong growth in first earnings report without Huang
item.description: Nvidia's latest earnings are the first time the chipmaker has reported financial results without founder and former CEO Jensen Huang at the helm.

item.title: Third grader detained by ICE returned to family
item.description: An eight-year-old born in Haiti was detained by ICE agents last week and was sent to a Texas facility. On Monday, he was reunited with his family back in San Diego.

item.title: Trump says "we're looking into" report that Iran may use dirty bomb on D.C.
item.description: President Trump responded to a CNN report about possible plans by Iran for a devastating attack in Washington, D.C. Weijia Jiang reports from the Philippines, the president's first stop on his historic Asia trip.

item.title: NSA's classified internal network goes down, sources say
item.description: Two U.S. officials tell CBS News that so far there is no evidence of a cyberattack.

item.title: Nvidia earnings report beats expectations, raising predictions for next year
item.description: Nvidia, the company whose chips power much of the AI revolution, released its first earnings report since CEO Jensen Huang resigned last week over his extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang offered to return to the company on Tuesday, but the board dismissed that idea. Kelly O'Grady has more.

item.title: Duffy says "I can't guarantee" that the FAA telecom network will work indefinitely
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration has halted the system upgrade linked to Friday's national ground stop, but officials are not willing to promise that the problems are behind us. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Tech outage at U.S. spy agency hampered its ability to communicate internally
item.description: The U.S. has experienced eight major outages in one week, including Tuesday's outages at Apple, Google and the National Security Agency. Both government and corporate officials say there is no evidence of a cyberattack, despite concerns. Jo Ling Kent has more.

item.title: Outcome of Alaska Senate race could take weeks to determine
item.description: The Senate race in Alaska, which has garnered widespread attention with two candidates named Dan Sullivan, remains in limbo.

item.title: Democrats have flipped 46 House seats. Here's the breakdown.
item.description: Democrats won control of the House by flipping more than 40 Republican-held seats, picking up perennial swing districts and seats that were once considered deep red.

item.title: U.S. launches strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The strikes came after Iran launched attacks against U.S. radar systems in Bahrain three times in less than a week.

item.title: Rep.-elect Sam Forstag says cutting health care costs is his top priority
item.description: Earlier this month, Sam Forstag became the first Democrat elected to the House from Montana since 1994. Forstag joined "The Takeout" to discuss his priorities for the next Congress.

item.title: Nvidia sees strong earnings report despite Jensen Huang scandal and resignation
item.description: Nvidia on Tuesday night held its first earnings call since Jensen Huang's resignation. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady reports and Heath Terry, head of AI research at Citi, joins with his thoughts.

item.title: Paris Hilton returns to Capitol to push for House vote on deepfake bill
item.description: The Senate passed the bipartisan legislation, titled the DEFIANCE Act, in January. It has stalled in the House.

item.title: Student accused of taking photos of planes for China to be detained
item.description: A student accused of working with a Chinese Communist Party representative to take photos of airplanes in Chicago — and lying about it to U.S. investigators — will be detained pending trial, a judge ruled.

item.title: Apple restores services after internal update caused outages
item.description: The company's system status shows that all Apple services, including iCloud sign-in, have been restored after experiencing issues earlier Tuesday.

item.title: 11/17: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: More tech issues hit the U.S. after a week of disruptions; Trump gets ready to meet with Xi and Putin.

item.title: California's Unfinished Business | Helping lawmakers hold themselves accountable
item.description: CBS News California built a first-of-its-kind public accountability tool tracking state audit recommendations to lawmakers — detailing what lawmakers were told to fix, how audit-backed bills died, and what remains unresolved.
